series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~15% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.259), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8403. Series context: trend strength 0.9999 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.259); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.457.
